survey: operations-research instance datasets, shape-matched for a routing-with-rewards evaluation
shape: Each entry was scored against a nine-field routing-with-rewards node model (the survey's own standard terms): location, travelTime, duration, prize, prizeProbability, territory, skills, lifecycle, deadline. An entry's fields list names the fields it carries directly; a -deriv suffix marks a field derivable from stored columns.
